packs.name: gnomAD common variants - chromosome 22
packs.description: Allele counts, frequencies, ancestry-group frequencies, and source quality filters.
packs.attribution: Genome Aggregation Database (gnomAD), Broad Institute and contributing studies. Converted to an indexed local reference format. Population frequency is not an individual's ancestry or disease probability.
packs.coverage: gnomAD exomes 4.1.1 chromosome 22, GRCh38. Complete scan of 4,845,199 source rows; retain FILTER=PASS alleles with overall AF>=0.001 (38,854 source rows selected). This is a common-variant chromosome subset, not genome-wide or rare-variant coverage.
